standards.description: Energy is transferred by electric currents; the bulb converts current energy into light and heat.
standards.traceDetail: Filament heat and glow visible when the loop closes.

standards.description: Moving objects and electric currents carry energy that devices convert into other forms.
standards.traceDetail: Current's energy becomes the filament's heat and emitted light.

standards.description: A complete circuit is needed for current; the bulb demonstrates a closed-loop path.
standards.traceDetail: The switch opening shows current halting and the glow dying.
